sentences.say: Indians reported nearly twenty thousand crore rupees lost to cyber fraud in twenty twenty-five.
sentences.caption: Indians reported losing nearly ₹20,000 crore to cyber fraud in 2025.

sentences.say: Scam Shield checks what you were just sent, before you act.
sentences.caption: Scam Shield checks what you were just sent, before you act.

sentences.say: Paste a message, or add a screenshot, a Q R code, a link or a voice note.
sentences.caption: Paste a message, or add a screenshot, a QR code, a link or a voice note.

sentences.say: English, Hindi and Hinglish are understood.
sentences.caption: English, Hindi and Hinglish are understood.

sentences.say: First, a fake K Y C message with a look-alike bank link. One tap runs a real check.
sentences.caption: First, a fake KYC message with a look-alike bank link. One tap runs a real check.

sentences.say: Gemini reads the message.
sentences.caption: Gemini reads the message.

sentences.say: The verdict is Scam, with a risk score and the type of scam.
sentences.caption: The verdict is Scam, with a risk score and the type of scam.

sentences.say: Every warning sign quotes the exact words that give it away.
sentences.caption: Every warning sign quotes the exact words that give it away.

sentences.say: The number and the link are already on the shared scam list: in this demo, three reports each.
sentences.caption: The number and the link are already on the shared scam list: in this demo, three reports each.

sentences.say: The link was opened in an isolated browser, so you see the fake bank form without opening it yourself.
sentences.caption: The link was opened in an isolated browser, so you see the fake bank form without opening it yourself.

sentences.say: Now a Q R code that says you will receive five thousand rupees.
sentences.caption: Now a QR code that says you will receive ₹5,000.

sentences.say: Scam Shield decodes it on the server, as part of the same check.
sentences.caption: Scam Shield decodes it on the server, as part of the same check.

sentences.say: The card shows what it really is: a payment request, to this U P I, I D. You never scan a code to receive money.
sentences.caption: The card shows what it really is: a payment request, to this UPI ID. You never scan a code to receive money.

sentences.say: Next, a voice note: a synthetic fake C B I officer, in Hinglish. Gemini writes down what was said.
sentences.caption: Next, a voice note: a synthetic fake CBI officer, in Hinglish. Gemini writes down what was said.

sentences.say: The verdict is Scam, a digital arrest threat.
sentences.caption: The verdict is Scam, a digital arrest threat.

sentences.say: It spots the arrest threat and the fee demand, and says to hang up.
sentences.caption: It spots the arrest threat and the fee demand, and says to hang up.

sentences.say: Even a payment screenshot. A buyer says they have paid, and wants you to ship the item. Gemini reads the image to check.
sentences.caption: Even a payment screenshot. A buyer says they have paid, and wants you to ship the item. Gemini reads the image to check.

sentences.say: The date is the thirty-first of September, which does not exist.
sentences.caption: The date is 31 September, which does not exist.

sentences.say: The transaction reference has the wrong length, and the sender name does not match the U P I, I D.
sentences.caption: The transaction reference has the wrong length, and the sender name does not match the UPI ID.

sentences.say: Then you can act.
sentences.caption: Then you can act.

sentences.say: To report the scam, sign in with Google, then add the scammer's number to the shared list.
sentences.caption: To report it: sign in with Google, then add the scammer's number to the shared list.

sentences.say: Draft the complaint for one nine three zero, or the cybercrime portal, with the amount lost.
sentences.caption: Draft the complaint for 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in, with the amount lost.

sentences.say: And share a warning card with family. This is the card the app made.
sentences.caption: And share a warning card with family. This is the card the app made.

sentences.say: It fits a phone screen too. One tap runs the check, and Report, Complaint and Share sit in a bar at the bottom.
sentences.caption: It fits a phone screen too. One tap runs the check, and Report, Complaint and Share sit in a bar at the bottom.

sentences.say: It works in Hindi too. One tap switches the whole app.
sentences.caption: It works in Hindi too. One tap switches the whole app.

sentences.say: The check runs in Hindi, and the verdict comes back in Hindi.
sentences.caption: The check runs in Hindi, and the verdict comes back in Hindi.

sentences.say: The Trends page shows reports by scam type and state, with demo data while the app is new.
sentences.caption: The Trends page shows reports by scam type and state, with demo data while the app is new.

sentences.say: Firebase Hosting serves the app and forwards API calls to a Cloud Run service.
sentences.caption: Firebase Hosting serves the app and forwards API calls to a Cloud Run service.

sentences.say: It checks the Firestore scam list, sends any link to a separate, isolated scanner, and asks Gemini on Vertex A I for a structured verdict.
sentences.caption: It checks the Firestore scam list, sends any link to a separate, isolated scanner, and asks Gemini on Vertex AI for a structured verdict.

sentences.say: Firebase handles sign-in and file storage.
sentences.caption: Firebase handles sign-in and file storage.

sentences.say: On one hundred eighty-five synthetic test cases, Scam Shield flagged all ninety scams, and wrongly flagged three point three percent of the ninety genuine messages.
sentences.caption: On 185 synthetic test cases: flagged all 90 scams, wrongly flagged 3.3% of 90 genuine messages.

sentences.say: It is a small test, not a guarantee.
sentences.caption: It is a small test, not a guarantee.

sentences.say: Scam Shield. Check before you click, pay or scan.
sentences.caption: Scam Shield. Check before you click, pay or scan.
